name: Intervals
brief: A contemporary photography gallery called Intervals. Black and white only, Helvetica only, no animation. Make historical photographs the main experience, with an exhibition introduction, selected works, artist information and an exhibition enquiry. No invented awards or sales claims.

context.subject: photography gallery
context.primary_action: view the photographs and enquire about an exhibition

name: Willow Public Library
brief: Willow public library, a welcoming neighbourhood place for readers of every age. Help residents find books, see opening hours, discover events and join the library. Green and yellow, approachable editorial design, useful on phones, no installation commands or software imagery.

name: Noor Dental
brief: Noor Dental, a calm dental clinic in Lahore for people anxious about visiting a dentist. English with an Urdu welcome. Explain first visits and treatment options clearly. Let visitors request an appointment. Soft sage, warm white, no animation, no invented doctors, testimonials, ratings or clinical promises. Illustrative photos must be labelled.

context.subject: dental clinic
context.audience: Lahore residents and anxious first-time patients

name: Hearth Operations
brief: Hearth bakery operations dashboard. A shift lead needs todays bake quantities, oven status, low stock and collection orders. Dense but calm, warm paper and brick red, usable real controls. Product demo data must be labelled. No marketing hero or invented business growth claims.

context.subject: bakery operations dashboard
context.primary_action: review todays bake and update production
